sanskrit: bhavitā prathito rājā triṣu lokeṣu viśrutaḥ yaśasā tejasā caiva vṛttena ca samanvitaḥ
english: He will become a celebrated king, renowned in all three worlds, endowed with fame, splendour, and righteous conduct.

sanskrit: dhārmikaṃ taṃ sutaṃ labdhvā pāṇḍus tāṃ punar abravīt prāhuḥ kṣatraṃ balajyeṣṭhaṃ balajyeṣṭhaṃ sutaṃ vṛṇu
english: Having obtained that righteous son, Pāṇḍu spoke to her again: 'They say the warrior class is highest by strength; choose a son who is greatest in strength.'

sanskrit: tatas tathoktā patyā tu vāyum evājuhāva sā tasmāj jajñe mahābāhur bhīmo bhīmaparākramaḥ
english: Commanded thus by her husband, she invoked Vāyu, the wind-god; from him was born the mighty-armed Bhīma, of terrible valour.

sanskrit: tam apy atibalaṃ jātaṃ vāg abhyavadad acyutam sarveṣāṃ balināṃ śreṣṭho jāto 'yam iti bhārata
english: When even that one of surpassing strength was born, a bodiless voice proclaimed: 'This one born is the greatest among all the strong,' O Bhārata.

sanskrit: idam atyadbhutaṃ cāsīj jātamātre vṛkodare yad aṅkāt patito mātuḥ śilāṃ gātrair acūrṇayat
english: This too was a great wonder at the very birth of Vṛkodara: having fallen from his mother's lap, he shattered a rock with his limbs.

sanskrit: kuntī vyāghrabhayodvignā sahasotpatitā kila nānvabudhyata saṃsuptam utsaṅge sve vṛkodaram
english: Kuntī, startled by fear of a tiger, had suddenly leapt up and did not notice that Vṛkodara was sleeping in her own lap.

sanskrit: tataḥ sa vajrasaṃghātaḥ kumāro 'bhyapatad girau patatā tena śatadhā śilā gātrair vicūrṇitā tāṃ śilāṃ cūrṇitāṃ dṛṣṭvā pāṇḍur vismayam āgamat
english: Then that boy, compact as a thunderbolt, fell upon the mountain rock, and as he fell the rock was shattered into a hundred pieces by his limbs; seeing that rock crushed, Pāṇḍu was astonished.

sanskrit: yasminn ahani bhīmas tu jajñe bharatasattama duryodhano 'pi tatraiva prajajñe vasudhādhipa
english: On the very day that Bhīma was born, O best of the Bhāratas, Duryodhana too was born there, O lord of the earth.

sanskrit: jāte vṛkodare pāṇḍur idaṃ bhūyo 'nvacintayat kathaṃ nu me varaḥ putro lokaśreṣṭho bhaved iti
english: After Vṛkodara was born, Pāṇḍu reflected further: 'How might I have an excellent son who is the finest in the world?'

sanskrit: daive puruṣakāre ca loko 'yaṃ hi pratiṣṭhitaḥ tatra daivaṃ tu vidhinā kālayuktena labhyate
english: This world indeed rests on both fate and human effort; of these, fate is attained through prescribed rites joined with the proper time.

sanskrit: indro hi rājā devānāṃ pradhāna iti naḥ śrutam aprameyabalotsāho vīryavān amitadyutiḥ
english: We have heard that Indra is the king and chief of the gods, of immeasurable strength and enterprise, endowed with heroism, of boundless splendour.

sanskrit: taṃ toṣayitvā tapasā putraṃ lapsye mahābalam yaṃ dāsyati sa me putraṃ sa varīyān bhaviṣyati karmaṇā manasā vācā tasmāt tapsye mahat tapaḥ
english: By satisfying him through austerity I shall obtain a son of great might; the son he grants me will be most excellent. By deed, thought, and word I shall therefore perform great penance.

sanskrit: tataḥ pāṇḍur mahātejā mantrayitvā maharṣibhiḥ dideśa kuntyāḥ kauravyo vrataṃ sāṃvatsaraṃ śubham
english: Then Pāṇḍu of great splendour, having consulted with the great seers, enjoined on Kuntī, the scion of the Kauravas, the auspicious vow lasting a full year.

sanskrit: ātmanā ca mahābāhur ekapādasthito 'bhavat ugraṃ sa tapa ātasthe parameṇa samādhinā
english: And the mighty-armed one himself stood on one foot and undertook fierce austerity with the highest concentration of mind.

sanskrit: ārirādhayiṣur devaṃ tridaśānāṃ tam īśvaram sūryeṇa saha dharmātmā paryavartata bhārata
english: Desiring to propitiate that lord of the thirty gods, the righteous-souled one revolved together with the sun, O Bhārata.

sanskrit: taṃ tu kālena mahatā vāsavaḥ pratyabhāṣata putraṃ tava pradāsyāmi triṣu lokeṣu viśrutam
english: After a long time, Vāsava spoke to him in reply: 'I shall grant you a son renowned in all three worlds.'

sanskrit: devānāṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ ca suhṛdāṃ cārthasādhakam sutaṃ te 'gryaṃ pradāsyāmi sarvāmitravināśanam
english: I shall give you a foremost son who will accomplish the purposes of gods, brahmins, and friends, and who will destroy all enemies.

sanskrit: ity uktaḥ kauravo rājā vāsavena mahātmanā uvāca kuntīṃ dharmātmā devarājavacaḥ smaran
english: Addressed thus by the great-souled Vāsava, the Kaurava king, righteous in soul, spoke to Kuntī, recalling the words of the king of gods.

sanskrit: nītimantaṃ mahātmānam ādityasamatejasam durādharṣaṃ kriyāvantam atīvādbhutadarśanam
english: One possessed of policy, great-souled, equal in splendour to the sun, difficult to assail, active in deeds, of truly wondrous appearance —

sanskrit: putraṃ janaya suśroṇi dhāma kṣatriyatejasām labdhaḥ prasādo devendrāt tam āhvaya śucismite
english: — such a son do you bear, O fair-hipped one, the very embodiment of kingly valour. The favour has been obtained from the lord of gods; invoke him, O bright-smiling one.

sanskrit: evam uktā tataḥ śakram ājuhāva yaśasvinī athājagāma devendro janayām āsa cārjunam
english: Thus addressed, the illustrious one invoked Śakra; Devendra came and begot Arjuna.

sanskrit: jātamātre kumāre tu vāg uvācāśarīriṇī mahāgambhīranirghoṣā nabho nādayatī tadā
english: At the very moment the boy was born, a bodiless voice spoke, of deep and resonant sound, causing the sky to reverberate.

sanskrit: kārtavīryasamaḥ kunti śibitulyaparākramaḥ eṣa śakra ivājeyo yaśas te prathayiṣyati
english: O Kuntī, equal to Kārtavīrya, of valour comparable to Śibi's, this one unconquerable like Śakra will spread your fame.

sanskrit: adityā viṣṇunā prītir yathābhūd abhivardhitā tathā viṣṇusamaḥ prītiṃ vardhayiṣyati te 'rjunaḥ
english: Just as Aditi's joy was increased by Viṣṇu, so Arjuna, equal to Viṣṇu, will increase your joy.

sanskrit: eṣa madrān vaśe kṛtvā kurūṃś ca saha kekayaiḥ cedikāśikarūṣāṃś ca kurulakṣma sudhāsyati
english: This one, having brought the Madras under his sway and the Kurus along with the Kekayas, and the Cedis, Kāśis, and Karūṣas, will adorn the glory of the Kuru line.

sanskrit: etasya bhujavīryeṇa khāṇḍave havyavāhanaḥ medasā sarvabhūtānāṃ tṛptiṃ yāsyati vai parām
english: By the strength of this one's arms, the fire-god in the Khāṇḍava forest will attain the utmost satisfaction with the fat of all creatures.

sanskrit: grāmaṇīś ca mahīpālān eṣa jitvā mahābalaḥ bhrātṛbhiḥ sahito vīras trīn medhān āhariṣyati
english: Having conquered chieftains and rulers of the earth, this mighty hero, together with his brothers, will perform three great sacrifices.

sanskrit: jāmadagnyasamaḥ kunti viṣṇutulyaparākramaḥ eṣa vīryavatāṃ śreṣṭho bhaviṣyaty aparājitaḥ
english: O Kuntī, equal to Jamadagni's son, of valour comparable to Viṣṇu's, this one will be the foremost of the heroic and will remain undefeated.

sanskrit: tathā divyāni cāstrāṇi nikhilāny āhariṣyati vipranaṣṭāṃ śriyaṃ cāyam āhartā puruṣarṣabhaḥ
english: Likewise this bull among men will acquire all divine weapons in their entirety, and will restore the prosperity that was lost to the brahmins.

sanskrit: etām atyadbhutāṃ vācaṃ kuntīputrasya sūtake uktavān vāyur ākāśe kuntī śuśrāva cāsya tām
english: The wind spoke this most wondrous speech in the sky at the birth of Kuntī's son, and Kuntī heard it.

sanskrit: vācam uccāritām uccais tāṃ niśamya tapasvinām babhūva paramo harṣaḥ śataśṛṅganivāsinām
english: Hearing that speech spoken aloud, the ascetics dwelling on mount Śataśṛṅga were filled with the utmost joy.

sanskrit: tathā devaṛṣīṇāṃ ca sendrāṇāṃ ca divaukasām ākāśe dundubhīnāṃ ca babhūva tumulaḥ svanaḥ
english: Likewise among the divine sages and the celestials together with Indra, and in the sky, there arose a tumultuous sound of kettledrums.

sanskrit: udatiṣṭhan mahāghoṣaḥ puṣpavṛṣṭibhir āvṛtaḥ samavetya ca devānāṃ gaṇāḥ pārtham apūjayan
english: A great clamour arose, accompanied by showers of flowers; and the hosts of gods, having assembled, honoured Pārtha.

sanskrit: kādraveyā vainateyā gandharvāpsarasas tathā prajānāṃ patayaḥ sarve sapta caiva maharṣayaḥ
english: The sons of Kadrū, the sons of Vinatā, the Gandharvas and Apsaras, all the lords of creatures, and the seven great sages as well —

sanskrit: bharadvājaḥ kaśyapo gautamaś ca; viśvāmitro jamadagnir vasiṣṭhaḥ yaś codito bhāskare 'bhūt pranaṣṭe; so 'py atrātrir bhagavān ājagāma
english: — Bharadvāja, Kaśyapa, and Gautama; Viśvāmitra, Jamadagni, Vasiṣṭha; and the one who appeared when the sun was eclipsed — that very blessed Atri also came there.

sanskrit: marīcir aṅgirāś caiva pulastyaḥ pulahaḥ kratuḥ dakṣaḥ prajāpatiś caiva gandharvāpsarasas tathā
english: Marīci, Aṅgiras, Pulastya, Pulaha, Kratu, Dakṣa, Prajāpati, and the Gandharvas and Apsaras likewise —

sanskrit: divyamālyāmbaradharāḥ sarvālaṃkārabhūṣitāḥ upagāyanti bībhatsum upanṛtyanti cāpsarāḥ gandharvaiḥ sahitaḥ śrīmān prāgāyata ca tumburuḥ
english: — wearing divine garlands and garments, adorned with all ornaments, the Apsaras sang and danced before Bībhatsu; the glorious Tumburu together with the Gandharvas sang.

sanskrit: bhīmasenograsenau ca ūrṇāyur anaghas tathā gopatir dhṛtarāṣṭraś ca sūryavarcāś ca saptamaḥ
english: Bhīmasena, Ugrasena, Urnayu, Anagha, Gopati, Dhṛtarāṣṭra, and Suryavarcas as the seventh —

sanskrit: yugapas tṛṇapaḥ kārṣṇir nandiś citrarathas tathā trayodaśaḥ śāliśirāḥ parjanyaś ca caturdaśaḥ
english: Yugapa, Trinapha, Kārṣṇi, Nandī, Citraratha as well, Shalisiras as the thirteenth, and Parjanya as the fourteenth —

sanskrit: kaliḥ pañcadaśaś cātra nāradaś caiva ṣoḍaśaḥ sad vā bṛhad vā bṛhakaḥ karālaś ca mahāyaśāḥ
english: Kali as the fifteenth here, and Nārada as the sixteenth; Sat, Brihad, Brihaka, and the greatly renowned Karāla —

sanskrit: brahmacārī bahuguṇaḥ suparṇaś ceti viśrutaḥ viśvāvasur bhumanyuś ca sucandro daśamas tathā
english: Brahmacārī, Bahuguna, the famous Suparṇa, Viśvāvasu, Bhūmanyu, and Sucandra as the tenth —

sanskrit: gītamādhuryasaṃpannau vikhyātau ca hahāhuhū ity ete devagandharvā jagus tatra nararṣabham
english: The famous Hāhā and Hūhū, endowed with sweetness of song — these divine Gandharvas all sang there for that bull among men.

sanskrit: tathaivāpsaraso hṛṣṭāḥ sarvālaṃkārabhūṣitāḥ nanṛtur vai mahābhāgā jaguś cāyatalocanāḥ
english: Likewise the greatly blessed Apsaras, joyful and adorned with all ornaments, danced and sang, their eyes wide and lovely.

sanskrit: anūnā cānavadyā ca priyamukhyā guṇāvarā adrikā ca tathā sācī miśrakeśī alambusā
english: Anuna, Anavadya, Priyamukha, Gunavara, Adrika, Śacī, Miśrakeśī, and Alambusā —

sanskrit: marīciḥ śicukā caiva vidyutparṇā tilottamā agnikā lakṣaṇā kṣemā devī rambhā manoramā
english: Marīci, Shicuka, Vidyutparṇa, Tilottamā, Agnika, Lakshana, Kṣema, Devi, Rambhā, and Manoramā —

sanskrit: asitā ca subāhuś ca supriyā suvapus tathā puṇḍarīkā sugandhā ca surathā ca pramāthinī
english: Asita, Subāhu, Supriya, Supavus, Puṇḍarīka, Sugandha, Suratha, and Pramathini —

sanskrit: kāmyā śāradvatī caiva nanṛtus tatra saṃghaśaḥ menakā sahajanyā ca parṇikā puñjikasthalā
english: Kamya and Sharadavati danced there in groups; Menakā, Sahajanya, Parnika, Puñjikasthalā —

sanskrit: kratusthalā ghṛtācī ca viśvācī pūrvacitty api umlocety abhivikhyātā pramloceti ca tā daśa urvaśy ekādaśīty etā jagur āyatalocanāḥ
english: Kratusthala, Ghṛtācī, Vishvaci, Purvacitti, the well-known Umloca, Pramloca — these ten, and Urvaśī as the eleventh — all these long-eyed ones sang.

sanskrit: dhātāryamā ca mitraś ca varuṇo 'ṃśo bhagas tathā indro vivasvān pūṣā ca tvaṣṭā ca savitā tathā
english: Dhata, Aryaman, Mitra, Varuṇa, Aṃśa, Bhaga, Indra, Vivasvat, Pusha, Tvaṣṭā, and Savitā —

sanskrit: parjanyaś caiva viṣṇuś ca ādityāḥ pāvakārciṣaḥ mahimānaṃ pāṇḍavasya vardhayanto 'mbare sthitāḥ
english: Parjanya and Viṣṇu — these Ādityas, blazing like fire, stood in the sky, magnifying the glory of the Pāṇḍava.

sanskrit: mṛgavyādhaś ca śarvaś ca nirṛtiś ca mahāyaśāḥ ajaikapād ahirbudhnyaḥ pinākī ca paraṃtapaḥ
english: Mṛgavyādha, Śarva, the greatly renowned Nirrita, Ajakapada, Ahirbudhnya, and Pinākī the scorcher of foes —

sanskrit: dahano 'theśvaraś caiva kapālī ca viśāṃ pate sthāṇur bhavaś ca bhagavān rudrās tatrāvatasthire
english: Dahana, Ishvara, Kapālī, O lord of people, Sthāṇu, and the blessed Bhava — these Rudras stood there.

sanskrit: aśvinau vasavaś cāṣṭau marutaś ca mahābalāḥ viśvedevās tathā sādhyās tatrāsan parisaṃsthitāḥ
english: The two Aśvins, the eight Vasus, the mighty Maruts, the Viśvedevas, and the Sādhyas — all these were assembled and stationed there.

sanskrit: karkoṭako 'tha śeṣaś ca vāsukiś ca bhujaṃgamaḥ kacchapaś cāpakuṇḍaś ca takṣakaś ca mahoragaḥ
english: Karkoṭaka, Śeṣa, the serpent Vāsuki, Kacchapa, Apakunda, and the great serpent Takṣaka —

sanskrit: āyayus tejasā yuktā mahākrodhā mahābalāḥ ete cānye ca bahavas tatra nāgā vyavasthitāḥ
english: — endowed with splendour, of great wrath, of great strength, they came; these and many other Nāgas were stationed there.

sanskrit: tārkṣyaś cāriṣṭanemiś ca garuḍaś cāsitadhvajaḥ aruṇaś cāruṇiś caiva vainateyā vyavasthitāḥ
english: Tarkhya, Ariṣṭanemi, Garuḍa of the dark banner, Aruṇa, and Āruṇi — the sons of Vinatā were stationed there.

sanskrit: tad dṛṣṭvā mahad āścaryaṃ vismitā munisattamāḥ adhikāṃ sma tato vṛttim avartan pāṇḍavān prati
english: Seeing that great wonder, the best of sages were astonished and thenceforth showed even greater regard toward the Pāṇḍavas.

sanskrit: pāṇḍus tu punar evaināṃ putralobhān mahāyaśāḥ prāhiṇod darśanīyāṅgīṃ kuntī tv enam athābravīt
english: But Pāṇḍu of great fame, out of desire for a son, urged the fair-limbed one again; Kuntī then spoke to him thus.

sanskrit: nātaś caturthaṃ prasavam āpatsv api vadanty uta ataḥ paraṃ cāriṇī syāt pañcame bandhakī bhavet
english: A fourth delivery is not sanctioned even in dire necessity, so they say; beyond that a woman becomes wanton, and at the fifth a harlot.

sanskrit: sa tvaṃ vidvan dharmam imaṃ buddhigamyaṃ kathaṃ nu mām apatyārthaṃ samutkramya pramādād iva bhāṣase
english: You who know this dharma, comprehensible to the intellect — how then do you speak to me, as if in heedlessness, urging me to transgress it for the sake of offspring?

sanskrit: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca kuntīputreṣu jāteṣu dhṛtarāṣṭrātmajeṣu ca madrarājasutā pāṇḍuṃ raho vacanam abravīt
english: Vaiśaṃpāyana said: When the sons of Kuntī and the sons of Dhṛtarāṣṭra had been born, the daughter of the king of Madra spoke privately to Pāṇḍu.

sanskrit: na me 'sti tvayi saṃtāpo viguṇe 'pi paraṃtapa nāvaratve varārhāyāḥ sthitvā cānagha nityadā
english: O scorcher of foes, I feel no sorrow toward you even in your affliction; nor in the inferiority of one who deserves the best, O sinless one, while dwelling with you always.

sanskrit: gāndhāryāś caiva nṛpate jātaṃ putraśataṃ tathā śrutvā na me tathā duḥkham abhavat kurunandana
english: O king, O delight of the Kurus, even hearing that a hundred sons have been born to Gāndhārī, my grief was not as great as this.

sanskrit: idaṃ tu me mahad duḥkhaṃ tulyatāyām aputratā diṣṭyā tv idānīṃ bhartur me kuntyām apy asti saṃtatiḥ
english: But this is my great sorrow — to be equal in status yet without a son. By good fortune, however, there is now offspring through Kuntī for my husband.

sanskrit: yadi tv apatyasaṃtānaṃ kuntirājasutā mayi kuryād anugraho me syāt tava cāpi hitaṃ bhavet
english: If the daughter of the Kuntiraja king would extend the lineage of offspring through me, it would be a favour to me and would also serve your welfare.

sanskrit: stambho hi me sapatnītvād vaktuṃ kuntisutāṃ prati yadi tu tvaṃ prasanno me svayam enāṃ pracodaya
english: For I am inhibited by rivalry with a co-wife from speaking to Kuntī's daughter myself; but if you are pleased with me, urge her yourself.

sanskrit: pāṇḍur uvāca mamāpy eṣa sadā mādri hṛdy arthaḥ parivartate na tu tvāṃ prasahe vaktum iṣṭāniṣṭavivakṣayā
english: Pāṇḍu said: O Mādrī, this very wish has always revolved in my heart too; but I did not venture to speak to you, weighing what is desirable and what is not.

sanskrit: tava tv idaṃ mataṃ jñātvā prayatiṣyāmy ataḥ param manye dhruvaṃ mayoktā sā vaco me pratipatsyate
english: But knowing this to be your wish, I shall endeavour henceforth; I believe that when spoken to by me she will certainly accept my words.

sanskrit: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca tataḥ kuntīṃ punaḥ pāṇḍur vivikta idam abravīt kulasya mama saṃtānaṃ lokasya ca kuru priyam
english: Vaiśaṃpāyana said: Then Pāṇḍu spoke these words to Kuntī again in private: 'Do what is dear to my lineage and to the world.'

sanskrit: mama cāpiṇḍanāśāya pūrveṣām api cātmanaḥ matpriyārthaṃ ca kalyāṇi kuru kalyāṇam uttamam
english: For the sake of preventing the extinction of offerings to me and to my ancestors, and for my own sake, O auspicious one, do this highest good deed.

sanskrit: yaśaso 'rthāya caiva tvaṃ kuru karma suduṣkaram prāpyādhipatyam indreṇa yajñair iṣṭaṃ yaśorthinā
english: For the sake of renown also, perform this most difficult act — just as Indra, desiring glory, obtained his lordship through sacrifices.

sanskrit: tathā mantravido viprās tapas taptvā suduṣkaram gurūn abhyupagacchanti yaśaso 'rthāya bhāmini
english: Likewise, O beautiful one, brahmins who know the mantras, having performed most arduous austerity, approach their teachers for the sake of renown.

sanskrit: tathā rājarṣayaḥ sarve brāhmaṇāś ca tapodhanāḥ cakrur uccāvacaṃ karma yaśaso 'rthāya duṣkaram
english: Likewise all the royal sages and the brahmins whose wealth is austerity have performed various difficult deeds, both high and low, for the sake of renown.

sanskrit: sā tvaṃ mādrīṃ plaveneva tārayemām anindite apatyasaṃvibhāgena parāṃ kīrtim avāpnuhi
english: O blameless one, you — as if by a raft — ferry Mādrī across; by sharing offspring with her, attain the highest glory.

sanskrit: evam uktābravīn mādrīṃ sakṛc cintaya daivatam tasmāt te bhavitāpatyam anurūpam asaṃśayam
english: Thus addressed, she said to Mādrī: 'Think of a deity just once; from that a fitting offspring will certainly be born to you, without doubt.'

sanskrit: tato mādrī vicāryaiva jagāma manasāśvinau tāv āgamya sutau tasyāṃ janayām āsatur yamau
english: Then Mādrī, having deliberated, went to the Aśvins in her mind; the two of them came and begot twin sons upon her.

sanskrit: nakulaṃ sahadevaṃ ca rūpeṇāpratimau bhuvi tathaiva tāv api yamau vāg uvācāśarīriṇī
english: Nakula and Sahadeva, unmatched in beauty in the world — at the birth of those twins too, a bodiless voice spoke.

sanskrit: rūpasattvaguṇopetāv etāv anyāñ janān ati bhāsatas tejasātyarthaṃ rūpadraviṇasaṃpadā
english: These two, endowed with beauty, courage, and virtue, surpass all other men, blazing exceedingly with splendour and with the wealth of beauty.

sanskrit: nāmāni cakrire teṣāṃ śataśṛṅganivāsinaḥ bhaktyā ca karmaṇā caiva tathāśīrbhir viśāṃ pate
english: The dwellers of Śataśṛṅga gave names to them with devotion, with ritual acts, and with blessings, O lord of peoples.

sanskrit: jyeṣṭhaṃ yudhiṣṭhirety āhur bhīmaseneti madhyamam arjuneti tṛtīyaṃ ca kuntīputrān akalpayan
english: The eldest of Kuntī's sons they called Yudhiṣṭhira, the middle one Bhīmasena, and the third Arjuna.
